proof_stage_definitions.implementation: Reuse or implement Rust owning the complete supported behavior, including substantive callbacks; retain reviewed assembly and remove live compute-C implementation dependency.
proof_stage_definitions.focused_checks: Run the relevant actual-body regression and error/lifetime checks under the existing ordinary profile; reuse matching accepted evidence.
proof_stage_definitions.production_link: Compile the real selected translation unit and Rust object, then prove default selection, ABI and ownership in the matched linked image. A C wrapper calling Rust is insufficient while substantive C remains.
proof_stage_definitions.native_validation: Demonstrate applicable actual native functional behavior on matching artifacts; record exact supported scope and unresolved branches. Model-only results are insufficient.

constraints: Preserve accepted live cpu.c/process.c correctness repairs until working Rust replacements have proof.

Reuse existing Rust and matching evidence. Do not repeat whole-image attribution per run or turn this into an exhaustive qualification program.
